claim_decision.forbidden_generalization: No effectiveness claim across varied real-world repositories.
claim_decision.strongest_supported_conclusion: Automatic pre-generation guidance showed directional gains in the controlled seven-task fixture (+2 governed compliant first attempts and +2 completed tasks), with no scope or operational penalty, but did not satisfy a frozen positive claim gate.

enforcement.interpretation: The deterministic gate remained active and fired once per arm, but both rejected first attempts were adjudicated architecturally compliant; it did not provide confirmed violation catches in this fixture.

paired_governed_efficiency.reason: Four governed pairs have no observed first-compliant call count in at least one arm, and the frozen protocol does not define numeric imputation or ranking for those null outcomes. Complete-pair results meet the median threshold but only 8 observed pairs favor treatment; the 10/15 result is a transparently labeled failure-ranked sensitivity, not the frozen estimand.

model_usage_to_first_compliant.method: sum maxima per unique assistant message id
